name: g_game_state
comment: Current game state: main() runs its handler every frame (see sheets/game_sections.csv). Change it with goto_state().

name: g_game_substate
comment: Step inside the current game state; each state handler switches on it.

name: g_frame_count
comment: Frames since boot (main() counts it up every frame).

name: g_draw_buffer
comment: Index (0 / 1) of the display buffer drawn this frame (get_draw_buffer()).

name: g_display_active
comment: 1 while the per-frame screen output runs; 0 while it is frozen (set_display_frozen()).

name: g_vsync_count
comment: Raised by the vertical blank callback; frame_wait_vsync() waits for it.

name: g_random_seed
comment: Random number seed; stepped while waiting for each frame (seed = (seed + 1) * 0x10DCD).

name: g_mode_settings
comment: Settings of the current game mode; its first byte is the mode number (values 0..8 select arcade, versus, team battle and the other modes; 7 and 8 are special-cased in many places).

name: g_mode_next_state
comment: Game state the current screen goes to when it is done (set by the game mode).

name: g_mode_next_substate
comment: Sub-state for g_mode_next_state.

name: g_load_queue
comment: Load queue: up to 8 entries of {u16 argument, u16 BNS file, u32 destination} (load_queue_add).

name: g_load_queue_count
comment: Number of entries in g_load_queue.

name: g_load_queue_pos
comment: Entry of g_load_queue being loaded by state 1.

name: g_load_then_state
comment: State goto_state() switches to after the queued loads.

name: g_load_then_substate
comment: Sub-state for g_load_then_state.

name: g_load_is_code
comment: Set when the running load is code (BNS file below 10): flush the instruction cache afterwards.

name: g_pad1_buttons
comment: Player 1 buttons this frame in the game's format (bit 12 up, 13 right, 14 down, 15 left, 4 triangle, 5 circle, 6 cross, 7 square, 0 L2, 1 R2, 2 L1, 3 R1, 8 select, 11 start).

name: g_pad2_buttons
comment: Player 2 buttons this frame (same format as g_pad1_buttons).

name: g_pad1_prev
comment: Player 1 buttons of the previous frame (to find newly pressed ones).

name: g_pad2_prev
comment: Player 2 buttons of the previous frame.

name: g_pad_pressed
comment: Per player (u16 [2]): buttons newly pressed this frame (menus).

name: g_pad_repeat
comment: Per player (u16 [2]): menu auto-repeat buttons (set on the press, then every 4 frames once held for 20).

name: g_pad_repeat_timers
comment: Per player 16 hold counters (one per button) for g_pad_repeat.

name: g_mode_work
comment: Start of the mode package / heap area. Screens that run without a package use it for their own state; the character select keeps its state here (+0 mode, then one 0xAC-byte block per player from +0x18: phase, cursor column / row, ...).

name: g_charsel_grid
comment: Character select portrait grid: 7 columns x 3 rows of 6-byte cells; byte 4 of a cell is the character id (character number * 4).

name: g_unlocked_characters
comment: Bit mask of unlocked characters (bit = character id >> 2); locked cells show a placeholder.

name: g_player_char
comment: Per player (u16 [2]): chosen character number.

name: g_player_costume
comment: Per player (u16 [2]): chosen costume (0..3, the button used to confirm); character id = g_player_char * 4 + costume.

name: g_player_has_choice
comment: Per player: nonzero if the player already has a character (continue / rematch), so the cursor starts on it.
